name: Sultamicillin
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 375 to 750 mg twice daily; usually 5 to 14 days, continuing 48 hours after symptoms resolve; at least 10 days for hemolytic streptococcal infections
2.25 g (six 375 mg tablets) as a single dose with probenecid 1 g

key_interactions.effect: Raises and prolongs ampicillin and sulbactam levels (used deliberately for gonorrhea).

common: Not listed in the retrieved source

contraindications: History of allergy to any penicillin
monitoring: Kidney function to set dosing frequency

sources.citation: Ministry of Health Singapore. (2026). Unasyn oral tablet 375 mg (sultamicillin tosylate) [SIN04892P; National Drug Formulary product information; last updated October 9, 2026]. Pfizer Private Limited.
